title: Completion of rewind and replay
statement: Let $x,a$ be Boolean words and let $i\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i\le |x|$. Starting in state $2$ with $a$ stored on the work tape, the work-tape head at position $|a|-1$, and empty output, after $2(|a|+1)$ steps the raw marker-stripping machine is halted and its output is exactly $a$.
replaced:
From the stripping machine's rewind state with retained buffer $a$ and work
head at displacement $\abs{a}-1$, exactly $2(\abs{a}+1)$ steps reach a halted
configuration whose output is exactly $a$.
